candidates-check.alt: The graph of f(x) = 2x cubed minus 9x squared plus 12x on the closed interval from 0 to 3, with four candidates: endpoints (0, 0) and (3, 9), critical points (1, 5) and (2, 4). A table lists the values; the absolute maximum is 9 at x = 3 and the absolute minimum is 0 at x = 0. The relative maximum (1, 5) and relative minimum (2, 4) are not absolute.
